title: AI approvals inbox (AiPendingActionsInbox) is unusable at phone width: the decision column is off-screen and the detail sheet clips Reject
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ① a defect measured by a dev of the `repo:cloud` lane while building objectstack-ai/cloud#4549 (hold confirmation-required MCP actions, email the person, approve on the AI approvals page). The page is the framework's component; cloud renders it unchanged. Owner ruling: a platform defect is fixed on the platform, never worked around in cloud. Reader: the `domain:ui` lane (objectstack fleet dispatches its own cards). Dedupe: `AiPendingActionsInbox phone width`, `AI approvals mobile table`, `approvals decision column off-screen`, `sheet Reject clipped` — none.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4549 (its last open item, "the approvals page at phone width", waits on this card).

## What was measured

Chromium at 360, 390 and 1280 px, on the real `AiPendingActionsInbox` with the console's Tailwind sheet, at cloud's pin (objectstack 18.6.0, `958ee0359496`). Unchanged on objectstack main `a9b36efffa1`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/AiPendingActionsInbox.tsx`: fixed column widths 140+140+120+110+110+260 make the table 1086 px wide. At 390 px it sits in a 306 px scroller (276 px at 360), and Approve / Reject / View sit at x 906–1013. A person on a phone cannot reach the decision without scrolling sideways.
- The first visible column is the internal tool name, not what the action does.
- The detail Sheet is 293 px (75% of the viewport); its Reject button runs to x 415, past the 390 px edge.
- At 1280 px everything fits. The inbox popover (`InboxPopover`) is fine at 360/390.

## Why it matters

The confirmation email sends the person to this page to approve or reject what their AI asked to do; many open it on a phone. A decision they cannot reach means the hold lapses (8 days) and the AI's work is lost, or they approve from the detail sheet without seeing the Reject choice.

## Done when

At 360 and 390 px the decision (Approve / Reject) and what the action does are visible without sideways scrolling, and the detail sheet's actions fit; a test pins it.
